purpose: Teach: タックル/浪人/飛鳥/ピカソ/ボンド/リンカーン/フットサル/ヤクルト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがラグビーのタックルが得意だった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was really good at rugby tackles.
lines.style: Gentle, reaching back into memory. Soft attack on the opening. Pace slows as he moves deeper into the past. Voice carries warmth and a trace of distance, like touching something precious through glass.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、浪人時代を懐かしまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather missed those ronin exam days so much, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm and knowing, as if she's been holding this memory alongside his all these years. Slight conspiratorial tone—she's gently correcting or redirecting him. Soft, musical cadence on the ending.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが飛鳥の遺跡を訪ねられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father visited the Asuka ruins.
lines.style: Same wistful reach into the past. Quieter than before, as if he's moving through a series of treasured moments. Delicate pause before naming the place. Voice holds the weight of shared history.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ピカソの作品集をお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather had quite the Picasso collection, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle redirect again, but now with a note of playful correction—she's reminding him or perhaps teasing him softly. Warm, attentive. She's meeting him in his nostalgia, not leaving him there alone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがボンドの映画を映画館でご覧になった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father watched Bond films at the cinema.
lines.style: The wistfulness deepens slightly. His voice is quieter now, more intimate. There's a stillness to it—he's not rushing through these moments. Each detail matters to him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、リンカーンの伝記をご愛読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was devoted to Lincoln's biography, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Her responses are becoming more affectionate as she gently weaves her own threads into his recollections. Knowing. A note of protectiveness—she's keeping these stories alive with him. Warm close on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフットサルのチームを応援された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father cheered for the futsal team.
lines.style: His voice carries a particular softness now—these moments are precious to him, and it shows. Slight lift on 'futsal,' as if that detail pleased him. The pace is unhurried. He's savoring.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ヤクルトの試合を球場でご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather watched the Yakult games at the stadium, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: This final response holds warmth and a gentle, loving finality—as if she's closing a door on these memories together, with tenderness. Slightly longer hold on the ending word. Intimate and close.
